ceu: ✦ The sextile between the Sun and Saturn

s.k: A day to learn and broaden your horizons.
t: The Moon widens your vision. What looked like a problem today may turn into a lesson.

The sextile between the Sun and Saturn brings together, in your favour, conversations and your image: the Sun brings willpower and visibility, Saturn brings discipline and responsibility. An idea from today could become a real project.
With Mercury retrograde in your home and family sector, it is a time to review and correct, not to sign in a hurry.
s.d: Read something that inspires you and keep one sentence.

s.k: Trust is the word of the day.
t: It is a day of quiet transformation. What ends today leaves room for something truer.

The sextile between the Sun and Saturn brings together, in your favour, money and your inner life: the Sun brings willpower and visibility, Saturn brings discipline and responsibility. Trust what you are building: today the sky lends a hand.
With Mercury retrograde in your communication sector, an old matter may come back, and it is worth closing it properly.
s.d: Take a long bath and imagine the water carrying away the weight of the day.

s.k: Today the other person is your mirror.
t: The Moon passes through your opposite sign and puts other people at the centre of the day. Today listening is worth more than talking.

The sextile between the Sun and Saturn brings together, in your favour, your image and friendships: the Sun brings willpower and visibility, Saturn brings discipline and responsibility. Smile more: kindness opens paths today.
With Mercury retrograde in your money sector, double-check dates, messages and contracts before moving forward.
s.d: If you have an agreement to make, put everything in writing.

s.k: Organise the day and the day will organise you.
t: Today your body speaks louder. Drink water, take breaks and do not ignore tiredness.

The sextile between the Sun and Saturn brings together, in your favour, your inner life and your career: the Sun brings willpower and visibility, Saturn brings discipline and responsibility. A small gesture can have a big effect today.
With Mercury retrograde in your self-image sector, it is a time to review and correct, not to sign in a hurry.
s.d: Go to bed half an hour earlier than usual.

s.k: Your heart wants a celebration and a little light.
t: With the Moon in your house of joy, creativity flows. Give shape to an idea you have been keeping to yourself.

The sextile between the Sun and Saturn brings together, in your favour, friendships and your horizons: the Sun brings willpower and visibility, Saturn brings discipline and responsibility. Be thankful for what goes well and say it out loud.
With Mercury retrograde in your inner life sector, an old matter may come back, and it is worth closing it properly.
s.d: Spend half an hour on a hobby just for the pleasure of it.

s.k: The heart of the day is at home.
t: Family and home take priority. A simple gesture of care has a very big effect today.

The sextile between the Sun and Saturn brings together, in your favour, your career and intimacy: the Sun brings willpower and visibility, Saturn brings discipline and responsibility. Let things flow without forcing them.
With Mercury retrograde in your friendship sector, double-check dates, messages and contracts before moving forward.
s.d: Put a plant or fresh flowers in your home.

s.k: One conversation can change the course of the day.
t: Ideas come pouring in. Write them down: not all of them are for today, but some will be worth gold later on.

The sextile between the Sun and Saturn brings together, in your favour, your horizons and relationships: the Sun brings willpower and visibility, Saturn brings discipline and responsibility. Put your heart and your head on the same side.
With Mercury retrograde in your career sector, it is a time to review and correct, not to sign in a hurry.
s.d: Read a few pages of a book instead of spending the time on your phone.

s.k: Look at what you have, not at what you lack.
t: The Moon passes through your area of money and security. It is a good day to look at your accounts calmly and without fear.

The sextile between the Sun and Saturn brings together, in your favour, intimacy and routine: the Sun brings willpower and visibility, Saturn brings discipline and responsibility. It is a day for sowing: what you do today grows over time.
With Mercury retrograde in your horizons sector, an old matter may come back, and it is worth closing it properly.
s.d: Review this week's spending and cut one thing you do not need.

s.k: A day to put yourself first.
t: With the Moon in your sign, your intuition is sharper than usual. Trust what you feel at first impression.

The sextile between the Sun and Saturn brings together, in your favour, relationships and romance: the Sun brings willpower and visibility, Saturn brings discipline and responsibility. Use it to take a step you keep putting off.
With Mercury retrograde in your intimacy sector, double-check dates, messages and contracts before moving forward.
s.d: Do something for yourself that you have been putting off for weeks.

s.k: A day to recharge on the inside.
t: With the Moon in your house of silence, dreams and intuition bring answers. Watch for the signs.

The sextile between the Sun and Saturn brings together, in your favour, routine and family: the Sun brings willpower and visibility, Saturn brings discipline and responsibility. Accept whatever help comes along, wherever it comes from.
With Mercury retrograde in your relationships sector, it is a time to review and correct, not to sign in a hurry.
s.d: Walk alone and listen to your own thoughts.

s.k: Share a dream with someone who believes in it.
t: The Moon favours sharing and helping one another. What you give to others comes back to you in other ways.

The sextile between the Sun and Saturn brings together, in your favour, romance and conversations: the Sun brings willpower and visibility, Saturn brings discipline and responsibility. It is a good moment to bring the two together in a single plan.
With Mercury retrograde in your daily routine sector, an old matter may come back, and it is worth closing it properly.
s.d: Join a cause or help someone in need.

s.k: Your goals ask for a firm step.
t: Others notice your effort. Do your best, even in the tasks nobody applauds.

The sextile between the Sun and Saturn brings together, in your favour, family and money: the Sun brings willpower and visibility, Saturn brings discipline and responsibility. Use this good energy to sort out what had stalled.
With Mercury retrograde in your romance sector, double-check dates, messages and contracts before moving forward.
s.d: Dress like the person you want to be at work.
